item.title: Faraway’s Unprecedented 16-Year Development Has Resulted in an Instant Classic
item.description: Faraway is the latest game from Steph Thirion, the solo developer behind 2009’s critically acclaimed iOS puzzler Eliss . (It’s published by Annapurna Interactive , the company arguably best-known for publishing offbeat games for wider audiences.) At a distance, Faraway looks like a small project: a high-score chasing arcade game about shooting stars. In reality, it’s a 16-year passion project that has finally come to fruition. Even in its one-button simplicity, Faraway feels like the kind of small-scale masterwork that so often gets overlooked in an industry that increasingly values Hollywood production over expressive gameplay.

item.title: Fortnite's Latest Reward Is So Good, It's Creating a Black Market
item.description: Fortnite launched its treasure hunting season this Sunday, which includes a One Piece collaboration that was one of the most anticipated collaborations of all time. No one expected a new item to steal the show, overshadowing the One Piece skins players had been requesting for years. Fans have been obsessing over the Pirate Shop access token, a recently introduced item that makes the whole Item Shop free for a fortnight. Thankfully, they might be able to end their search earlier than expected, as Treasure Hours are scheduled to begin soon.

item.title: D&D World of Warcraft Designer Learned From the Game’s Most Controversial Edition
item.description: The Dungeons & Dragons: World of Warcraft Gameplay Expansion allows Dungeon Masters to run games in the world of Azeroth where players battle bosses in dungeons inspired by the MMORPG. But lead designer James Wyatt never wanted those adventures to feel too much like the video game.

item.title: 20 Years Later, Bong Joon-Ho Looks Back at His Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece: 'It Was a Very Tough Process'
item.description: "I don't know exactly what it was," Bong said at the time. "What is clear is that it was a living creature, and it wasn't human. Its size was probably similar to a monster from a movie."

item.title: Netflix's Assassin's Creed Live-Action Series Officially Wraps Up Filming
item.description: Netflix unveiled its plans to make a live-action Assassin's Creed series in 2020 . Development only began in 2025 when Halo 's screenwriter David Wiener and Roberto Patino came on board . Six years after the announcement of this project, as reported by Matt's Inside Line , filming is complete. It's now time to get it ready for the TV screen as the series enters the post-production phase.

item.title: Apple TV's Best Sci-Fi Show Begins Filming for Season 2, but the Wait Will Be Long
item.description: Apple TV's hit 2025 sci-fi show, Pluribus , has reportedly started filming for its season 2. On Oct. 1, Production List reported that Pluribus season 2 was in pre-production, with filming scheduled to begin on Oct. 31. While Apple has not released any official statements, Forbes reported on Nov. 2 that shooting for season 2 of Pluribus has begun in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

item.title: 'Wonder Man' Actor Officially Breaks Silence on the Marvel Show's Sudden Cancellation
item.description: Marvel Studios ' six-year experiment in streaming television seems to be winding down, at least for the moment. This has been clear for a while now (despite some vague promises of more new series in the future), but perhaps the biggest sign that the Marvel Cinematic Universe was retreating from live-action TV was the sudden cancellation of Wonder Man .

item.title: 25 Years Later, Aragorn's Best Lord of the Rings Quote Still Defines the Entire Trilogy
item.description: Peter Jackson’s adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien’s The Lord of the Rings trilogy remains one of cinema’s most poignant and beautiful works. For better or worse, the trilogy also helped shape the visual style we now associate with fantasy. No matter how much time has passed, The Lord of the Rings has left a lasting mark on the genre.
